integrity: The proof classifies every subgroup outside the abelian kernel, derives an exact if-and-only-if permutability criterion, and counts its fibers in the quotient. The cyclic formula is a direct specialization. Exhaustive finite computation is used only as replay and specialization checking.
scientific_limitations: The subgroup formula contains an exact double sum over the subgroup lattice of A/<y>; it is not further reduced to a single invariant-factor product formula.
The result is restricted to generalized dicyclic groups and does not address arbitrary index-two extensions of abelian groups.
An equivalent arbitrary-kernel formula could exist under alternate generalized-dicyclic notation or in unindexed literature.
title: Exact lattice formulas for commutativity degrees of arbitrary generalized dicyclic groups
